subject: DUE TO APPROACHING THE MAXIMUM NUMBER OF NOTAM MESSAGES
text:
A6422/26 NOTAMR A5398/26
Q) LRBB/QAFXX/IV/NBO/E /000/999/4501N02531E234
A) LRBB B) 2611250908 C) 2612312359
E) DUE TO APPROACHING THE MAXIMUM NUMBER OF NOTAM MESSAGES 
   IN SERIES C PER YEAR, STARTING WITH 26 NOV 2026, 0000 UTC, 
   INFORMATION RELATING TO AIRSPACE RESERVATIONS (RESTRICTIONS),
   EXCEPT DANGER AREAS AND UNMANNED AIRCRAFT FLIGHTS, 
   WILL BE ISSUED IN NOTAM SERIES D.
